issues.title: Ingest Yell County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $14,801,293 across 33 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($5,500,779), Yell County Road Department ($3,917,417), County Jail 0.25% O & M ($1,196,254). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
